selection_rule: Exactly three centred-axis development variants and three translated-axis held-out variants are frozen below. No substitutions, split moves, profile edits, axis changes, angle changes, grammar expansion, or extra rows are permitted after candidate production or audit begins.

candidate_producer.admission_boundary: M105 follow-on output remains experimental and cannot add an executable manifest, corpus/provider input, training input, runtime resource, or active case-library record without separately selected production, review, and promotion workpacks.

q01_required_facts: one planar closed six-segment stepped radial profile in the XZ plane, expressed by inner_radius, lower_outer_radius, upper_outer_radius, lower_height, upper_height, and z_min
one declared axis line with origin (axis_x, 0, z_min) and direction parallel to +Z
a full 360 degree rotational extent and a profile entirely on the positive radial side of the declared axis
the profile has no self-intersection and all radii/heights satisfy the frozen strict inequalities
q01_rejections: profile crossing or touching the axis
contract.q02_allowed_action: Create exactly the declared six-segment planar wire and face, then apply one OCCT full-angle revolve about the frozen +Z-oriented axis; +Z is an API convention only because the reversed axis has the same final B-Rep at 360 degrees.
preconditions: the six-segment profile is closed, simple, planar in XZ, and entirely at x > axis_x
the axis is the line through (axis_x, 0, z_min) parallel to +Z
all declared clearances are strictly positive
semantic_invariants: one through axial bore has radius inner_radius
the lower and upper exterior cylinders have radii lower_outer_radius and upper_outer_radius respectively
the upper exterior radius applies only above lower_height
the result is a full revolution with no partial-angle radial end faces
the declared axis and profile are sufficient for the frozen deterministic construction only
unsupported_conditions: partial-angle, helical, swept, lofted, or multi-profile construction
profiles that touch or cross the axis
arbitrary curves, splines, fillets, chamfers, draft, shell, rib, or boolean post-processing
multiple axes, nested revolutions, or multi-solid output
inferring a signed revolve direction from a full-revolution B-Rep
generic axis/profile recovery or generic B-Rep-to-sequence inference

geometry: existing geometry replay gates against the deterministic reference output for every frozen row
sequence: exact two-operation sequence with SketchSteppedRadialProfile consumed by one 360-degree RevolveFace about the declared axis
editability: inner radius, lower outer radius, upper outer radius, lower height, upper height, and declared axis translation mutations preserve all strict preconditions and declared observables
semantic: one solid, one through axial bore, two declared exterior radii, upper step height, full-angle topology, and axis-relative profile placement
hash_stability: two clean-directory normalized STEP hashes for every frozen row
split_isolation: revolve_centered only in development and revolve_offset only in held_out

negative_controls: wrong_axis: displace the axis from the frozen axis_x while retaining the profile coordinates; reject by axis-relative bore and exterior-radius checks
partial_angle: replace 360 degrees with 270 degrees; reject by radial end faces and full-revolution topology checks
degenerate_profile: set upper_outer_radius less than or equal to inner_radius or lower_height greater than or equal to upper_height; reject before construction
split_leak: place a centred family ID in held_out or an offset family ID in development; reject before production
